appearance: Latin complexion, Bohemian clothing style, long and ratty hair. His outfit consists of the Nolasco Family gang colors. He has ritual scars on the inside of his palms - the mark that he is able to pilot a vehicle while wounded.
personality: Rebellious, antisocial, violent. He uses people for his goals, but is loyal to the end for his proven friends.
